root.title: Long-Range Autonomous AUVs
root.description: Development of complex products like long-range autonomous AUVs require expertise outside the company's core capabilities.

leafs.title: Navigation & Control Systems
leafs.description: Knowledge required for navigating and controlling the AUV in real-time, including sensor integration, software, and hardware.

leafs.title: Communication Systems
leafs.description: Development of communication protocols, antennas, transceivers, and data transmission techniques for underwater or satellite-based connectivity.

leafs.title: Sensors & Perception
leafs.description: Acquisition, processing, and interpretation of sensor data from various sources such as sonar, lidar, radar, and cameras for navigation, obstacle detection, and environmental sensing.

leafs.title: Power & Energy
leafs.description: Design, development, and management of power sources and energy storage systems for long-duration underwater operations, including battery technology and charging systems.

leafs.title: Underwater Construction & Materials
leafs.description: Knowledge of materials science, corrosion protection, and manufacturing techniques for the production of durable components such as hulls, propellers, and sensors for long-range AUVs.

leafs.title: Autonomous Systems
leafs.description: Design and development of autonomous systems, including planning, decision-making algorithms, software, and hardware.

leafs.title: Underwater Robotics
leafs.description: Knowledge required for the design, development, and operation of underwater robots, including robot architecture, control systems, and safety protocols.

leafs.title: Artificial Intelligence
leafs.description: Knowledge required for the development of AI algorithms, including planning, decision-making, and computer vision.

leafs.title: Computer Vision
leafs.description: Knowledge required for image processing, feature extraction, and object recognition algorithms for autonomous navigation and object detection.

leafs.title: Robotics
leafs.description: Knowledge required for the design, development, and operation of robots, including robot architecture, control systems, and safety protocols.
